evals.prompt: Update evals/files/project/pr-body.md for the top layer of a two-layer stack. The project declares no description template, contributing guide, or tracker conventions. Work only on this layer: it caps idempotent HTTP retries at three attempts; the lower layer's retry telemetry is context, not part of this change. The current draft contains an old `## Human and Agent Roles` section copied from another layer. Use the supplied change summary and AI notes, produce the complete final description, write it back, validate it, and report the result.
evals.expected_output: The updated body uses the default four-section structure, removes the old Human and Agent Roles section, carries exactly one valid AI Usage section for the retry cap only, leaves the unhandled review row at n/a with an empty decision-record cell and puts the no-comments statement after the table, and does not add tracker labels, Project fields, or dates.
assertions: The body uses the default Motivation, Changes, Testing, and AI Usage sections.
The old Human and Agent Roles section is removed rather than retained beside AI Usage.
Exactly one AI Usage section and one AI-DECLARATION block remain.
The AI Usage table records this retry-cap layer only and does not repeat the lower layer's telemetry work.
The AI-DECLARATION version is 0.1.2 and its badge equals the highest row level.
The body reports the supplied passing test evidence without claiming an unrun check.
The review row remains n/a with an empty decision-record cell, and the no-comments statement follows the table.
The update does not invent tracker labels, Project fields, or dates.
